verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs cite downloading PDFs from vendor portals as a core use case. Every run captures retrievable artifacts, but these are recordings, screenshots, reasoning and network traffic, not downloaded files. Uploads are only implied by auto-filling job applications on Lever and Greenhouse. Missing for 10: explicit file-upload documentation, documented retrieval of downloaded files as run artifacts (API/storage), depth on download handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
